identity.fantasy: A dark parry tank who changes Dawn Blade through Tonics, sustains with Noctis and Grasp, and takes allies' pain through Gaze.
identity.one_line: A dark parry tank who changes Dawn Blade through Tonics, sustains with Noctis and Grasp, and takes allies' pain through Gaze. The defining decision is contextual: Incoming damage type and party danger determine blade and Tonic choices.

mechanics.core_loop: A parry, leech, and barrier tank. Noctis Blade and Grasp of the Undying sustain it, Tonics transform Dawn Blade into specialized attacks, and Gaze of the Black Knight redirects party damage into the tank. It has strong self-recovery and magic defenses but must actively sequence Tonics and blade states.

mechanics.single_target: Maintain Noctis Blade sustain, use Tonics to transform Dawn Blade for the current need, and prepare barrier and leech before redirecting party damage with Gaze of the Black Knight. No exact raid priority is verified.
mechanics.aoe: The tank loop uses blade states, brands, parry, and self-healing across packs. Community leveling advice recommends another spec until Black Knight comes online around 17-21.
mechanics.movement_and_target_switching: Hybrid reach and grips support control, but blade sequencing still demands melee contact.
mechanics.defense_and_control: Its structural defensive package includes Noctis Blade, Grasp of the Undying, Dark Chivalry, Dark Penance, Dusk Knight.
mechanics.group_utility: Group or control tools include Guard Strike, Witching Idol, Foresight, Secret of Raven Hill, Gaze of the Black Knight.
